architecture.mechanism: Digital twin-based fault diagnosis using data acquisition, digital modeling, and data analysis to identify hidden faults such as stator core interlaminar insulation degradation causing excessive eddy current heating under no-load conditions.
architecture.intervention: Construct a digital twin of the 3-phase induction conveyor drive motor by integrating real-time no-load thermal, voltage, and current data acquisition with a physics-based digital model to isolate the specific loss component driving the overheating despite balanced winding resistance and stable 400V supply.
architecture.expected_effect: The digital twin model will pinpoint the anomalous no-load loss source (e.g., stator core losses) enabling targeted repair or parameter correction, eliminating the thermal overload trip after 20 minutes of no-load running.
architecture.falsification_test: Run the digital twin diagnostic and perform a no-load input power test; if the measured no-load input power matches the healthy baseline predicted by the digital model within 5 percent and the motor does not overheat, the hypothesized hidden fault mechanism is falsified.

challenge.kill_reason: the mechanism-space distinctness adjudication counts 1 materially distinct mechanism(s) (< 2, mechanism_distinctness/2.0.0) — the run generated nothing worth attacking (Art. LXXXIV, R514)
